newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: ROKISHKIS CHEESE FIVE MONTHS SALES UP.
newsitem.headline: ROKISHKIS CHEESE FIVE MONTHS SALES UP.

text.p: Lithuania's official list company Rokishkis Cheese said on Tuesday that its sales rose to 55.8 million litas during the first five months of 1997 compared to 30.3 million litas in the same period last year.
The company's financial analyst Valerija Shimeniene also told Reuters that the sales of Rokishkis Cheese in May were 13 million litas compared to 9.9 million litas in April.
"Sales are growing together with an increasing volume of milk bought for the production of cheese," Shimeniene said.
She said that the company bought 45,000 tonnes of milk in the first five months of the year compared to 30,000 tonnes in the same period in 1996.
"Our sales this year have also increased because we sold some cheese we produced last year," Shimeniene added.
The company reported net profit for the first four months of the year of 5.9 million litas.
The company posted its sales of 123.46 million litas and audited net profit of 10.46 million litas for 1996.
"We expect our net profit figures for May around June 10," Shimeniene said.
Rokishkis Cheese is one of the blue chips of the Vilnius bourse.
